mapper.sql: id, user_id, file_id, share_code, expire_time, download_count, created_at, status
mapper.insert: insert into share (id, user_id, file_id, share_code, expire_time, download_count, status) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{fileId}, #{shareCode}, #{expireTime}, #{downloadCount}, #{status})
mapper.select:
select
from share where id = #{id} and status = 1 and expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

select
from share where share_code = #{shareCode} and status = 1 and expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

select
from share where user_id = #{userId} and status = 1 order by created_at desc
mapper.update: update share set download_count = download_count + 1 where id = #{id} and status = 1
update share set status = 0 where expire_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP and status = 1
mapper.select: select count(1) from share where id = #{id} and status = 1 and expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
